The '''Fifth Alsakan Conflict''' was one of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars that pitted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its influential [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and its allies. Beginning approximately [[13,050 BBY]], the conflict lasted until around [[12,700 BBY]], and saw fighting across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Alsakan began using a new [[Alsakan cruiser (Fifth Alsakan Conflict)|class of cruiser]] during the conflict, and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hirken]] made great use of the cruisers during his [[Admiral Hirken's campaign in the Northern Dependencies|defense]] of Alsakan colony worlds in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] region in [[12,980 BBY]]. His campaign included battles at [[Battle of the Iridonia system|Iridonia]], [[Battle of the Glee Anselm system|Glee Anselm]], [[Battle of the Xa Fel system|Xa Fel]], [[Battle of the Dachat system|Dachat]], [[Battle of the Pyria system|Borleias]], and [[Battle of the Twith system|Twith]]. Near the end of the conflict, a battle later known as the [[Resistance on Cyrillia]] occurred at the planet [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]], though the war as a whole ended in a ceasefire that lasted [[Sixth Alsakan Conflict|almost a millennium]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fifth Alsakan Conflict's only mention thus far has been in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which explained the history of the Alsakan Conflicts.<ref name="Warfare" />
